qc.purpose: Run standard target-only OMOP characterization alongside the source-aware validation without treating DQD or Achilles as certification.
qc.thresholds: Default v5.4 thresholds; record exact package version and threshold-file fingerprints before execution. No post-hoc threshold changes.
qc.safety: Frozen target read-only. Achilles writes only to a separately provisioned results and scratch schema; no source or OMOP target schema writes. DQD writeToTable=FALSE.
qc.publication_rule: Report raw run counts and reasons for failures, after aggregate disclosure review. Do not present passed percentage as certification or assume checks pass.
qc.planned_comparison: Target-only DQD outcomes versus source-based DX_DATE exclusions, diagnosis-selection mechanism, and concept-zero drug routing.

interpretability.aim: Test whether observed model attributions change with end-to-end population selection or representation; feature importance is not a causal risk-factor effect.
interpretability.split: Reuse locked Stage E SHA-256 patient hash rule for 70/30 train/test. Check aligned identities, anchors, labels and split membership. Never write identifiers or row-level predictions to public output.
interpretability.preprocessing: Numeric training-median and binary training-mode imputation independently per training population; no test-leakage.

importance.primary: Held-out positive-class permutation importance for AUROC, 20 repeats, with a common matched test-patient comparison.
importance.secondary: SHAP interventional TreeExplainer with a common 200-row training-reference background sampled with fixed random seed; fixed matched test sample and positive-class explanation scale.
cautions: Correlated prior-utilization features share importance unpredictably.
Attributions are model and reference distribution dependent.
SHAP differences are not causal importance or transportability evidence.

interpretability.ascertainment_sensitivity: Repeat models excluding prior_365d_ischemic_stroke_indicator, because it requires recorded DX_DATE in Stage E. If harmonized re-ascertainment is later implemented, report it as an additional independent sensitivity.
interpretability.outputs: Aggregate model performance, feature permutation means/SD, SHAP mean abs contributions, rank changes and anchors; no row-level patient data.
interpretability.publication_rule: Provisional until validated. Differences must be repeatable and interpretable under matched evaluation populations to justify main-text claim.
